selection_rule: lowest VALIDATION MAE among non-trivial feature sets (test not used)
recommendation_rule: recommend only if the selected model's MAE improvement over EVERY baseline is statistically significant (paired, date-clustered one-sided t test, p < 0.05) on BOTH validation and test

verified_news_only.note: news this system held before each 09:15 IST cut-off (fetched_at <= cut-off)

recommendation: no candidate: the selected model does not SIGNIFICANTLY beat every baseline on both validation and test
